name: Separate technical validation from visual acceptance
description: For visual deliverables, establish technical validity and user-visible quality as distinct gates. Test one representative result in the real renderer or viewer, request feedback before multiplying variants, and preserve the accepted baseline during later changes.
conditions: The result is judged by appearance or design fidelity
Static, structural or server tests cannot reproduce the user's final view
tradeoffs: A pilot and feedback step can delay batch production
User approval applies to the tested version and view, not all future environments

evidence.description: Transparent glass passed technical checks but failed visual acceptance
Structurally validated house was rejected for design quality
Discrete fog carriers failed visual continuity despite functional integration
Approved baseline and three-view visual acceptance were preserved
